name: Summer Playground Camp
operator_name: City of Cranston Parks and Recreation Department
description_short: A 6-week city-run day program for Cranston residents ages 6-12, held rain or shine at four playground sites and built around field trips and activities. Campers bring their own lunch and must be picked up by 4:00pm.
activities: Field trips (bowling, roller skating, Spring Lake, Top Golf)

sources.note: Re-checked 2026-11-12: 'Summer Playground Camp ... 6-week day camp program ... rain or shine ... ages 6-8 and 9-12'; four playground sites; '$175 per week' / '$165 per week' (additional child); 'MUST bring their own lunch'; 'MUST BE picked up by 4:00pm'; Cranston residents only. Address is the Recreation Office (155 Gansett Avenue), where shirts are picked up.

'2026 Summer Camp Activity Calendar' linked from the page ('2026 PLAYGROUND PROGRAM SCHEDULE 6-12 YEAR OLDS'): weeks start June 29, July 6, 13, 20, 27 and Aug 3; '7/3/2026 NO CAMP'; Budlong Pool, bowling, United Skates, Spring Lake, performers.
